text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the fourth corner and into the 
final stretch! Every Umamusume unleashes 
their sprint all at once! Who will seize 
the glorious crown of the Takarazuka 
Kinen?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(—There had always been an eerie sense of 
wrongness.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Aaaaaaaagh...!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan...!! You've come so far that you 
can even—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Kh, as if I'd ever hand it over!! 
WOOOOOAAAAAAAGH!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(A roar. A surge. A blazing fighting 
spirit. Swallowing everything whole, and 
then—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(So fierce it feels as though... it could 
burn everything to the ground without a 
trace—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —No, it's not.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(I won't be swallowed up! Nor will I be 
burned to ashes!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Because I—no, we are!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown takes the lead!! Satono Crown 
takes the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Satono Crown... and across 
the line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She did it, Satono Crown!! The crown of 
the Grand Prix champion is now splendidly 
held in her hands!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaahhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, Duramente-san—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...!? K-Kita-san, what's wro—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Cheval, help me! We're carrying both of 
them!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, y-yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After being carried in by Satono Crown and 
the others, the two were examined by a 
doctor—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That Kitasan Black had suffered a dizzy 
spell due to accumulated fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And it was discovered that Duramente 
had injured her left leg."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. ...Thanks for taking care of 
me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san!? You don't have to stand up 
just yet—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —I'm fine. I can walk. I can stand.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I'm gravely injured. They 
just told me I won't be able to run right 
away...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...How pathetic of me. And yet... I'm only 
halfway through my journey.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Even though there's no time to stand 
still...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"A-and I... I couldn't do anything today 
except put on a pathetic run..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, but... I won't stop. This is no time 
for that!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Train harder, push harder, drive myself to 
the limit... I'm gonna be even stronger—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Then next time, I'll be the one to win.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I mean, isn't it obvious? It's simply the 
natural way of things.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Pushing themselves even when injured. 
Forcing themselves even when their bodies 
are at their limits. To girls like that—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I honestly don't feel like I could ever 
lose to girls who've neglected their 
'preparation' like that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ngh, Kura-chan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "...Hey. Wanna go outside for a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Even on a GⅠ day, there really isn't 
anyone around at this hour, is there?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It was so lively just a moment ago... 
Fufu, it feels kind of strange.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for dragging you along with me, 
Duramente-san. How are your legs feeling? 
Are they in pain?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I told you. Walking is no problem at all. 
...Why did you come here, though?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Look over there. Please, take a look.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"With this few people around, you can see 
the course really clearly."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If it's us—we can kindle a flame out 
there, one far greater than today's.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Don't you agree, Duramente-san?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course, today's match was heated too. 
Still, it'd be a waste to completely burn 
out.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe for a second that today 
was my limit.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If it's us, we can reach even greater 
heights. Blazing so dazzlingly and 
intensely, like no one has ever seen 
before.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Like fireworks that color the festival. 
Like a bonfire proclaiming the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“However, being able to do that isn't with 
a Duramente who pushes herself too far. 
Nor is it with a Kitasan Black who acts 
recklessly.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fully prepared, trained, and conditioned. 
Against all of you, who are at your very 
best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In Satono Crown's words, there are only 
facts. No lies, no deception, and not even 
gentle falsehoods to soothe the panicked 
pair.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because she—who had always prepared 
flawlessly—knew."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her rivals' strengths. Their growth. 
Perhaps even more intimately than they 
knew themselves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's why her words held nothing but pure 
facts.
choice_data_list: (I know it all too well. And surely—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Even them.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
We're canceling the trip to this year's 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Our race schedule for the rest of the 
year, too. All of it goes back to the 
drawing board.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
There is only one thing we must do, one 
thing we must aim for. ...Rest, and a full 
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ngh, I... I am...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Kura-chan. Race me one more time at the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I won't run like I did today ever again. 
I'll prepare. I'll think things through 
properly. Just like Kura-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So—!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I accept the challenge. ...Is that 
alright with you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...! ...All riiiight!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna show you that I can become 
truly strong! So I won't lose to Kura-chan 
and the others! —Because I want to beat 
them!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Keep on sharpening each other to 
your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
When she finally returns... I'll show her 
that I've surpassed her even further.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, bold words, Duramente-san! Hehe, but 
it won't be that easy!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if to blow away the nighttime quiet, 
the laughter of peers echoed across 
Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It spread brightly, as if illuminating the 
future ahead—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, hold on! When did you wander off, 
Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to burn with passion with you, 
too, you know? Hey, which race are we 
aiming for next?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I'm... sorry. Right now... not 
yet......

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to apologize, Cheval. Just 
promise me we'll race each other again!
choice_data_list:
Well... everyone, should we head back 
soon?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! You're right, it'll get way too 
late!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, why don't you all ride in our 
car? We're staying at the same inn anyway, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Satono Crown and the others 
returned to the inn, and each rested up 
leisurely for what was to come...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown's next target is the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn). Her greatest rival is 
Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Once again, the days of hard work begin...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't answer. Not yet...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Not... yet...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: However—!!
